name: 2brain
description: Capture AI work sessions into a second brain vault over MCP.

area.title: Area
area.description: Vault area that session notes are filed under. Leave empty to let the capture session choose.

server_name.title: MCP server name
server_name.description: Name of the MCP server that points at your vault.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model used by the headless capture session.

min_user_prompts.title: Minimum user prompts
min_user_prompts.description: Sessions with fewer user prompts than this are not captured.

note_language.title: Note language
note_language.description: Language code for the generated notes.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn automatic capture on or off.
